inputs.name: containerd_version
inputs.description: containerd release to install, such as "2.4.2". Change containerd_checksums with it.

inputs.name: containerd_checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the amd64 and arm64 containerd tarballs, from the release's .sha256sum files. Change these with containerd_version.

inputs.name: runc_version
inputs.description: runc release to install, such as "1.5.2". Change runc_checksums with it.

inputs.name: runc_checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the runc.amd64 and runc.arm64 binaries, from the release's runc.sha256sum. Change these with runc_version.

inputs.name: cni_version
inputs.description: CNI plugins release to install, such as "1.9.1". Change cni_checksums with it.

inputs.name: cni_checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the amd64 and arm64 CNI plugin tarballs, from the release's .sha256 files. Change these with cni_version.

inputs.name: config_toml
inputs.description: Contents of /etc/containerd/config.toml. containerd fills in its defaults for anything this leaves out. It's stored in state, so keep registry passwords out of it.
